prompt.executed_utf8: 傍晚小厨房的真人实拍的手 与手绘发光2d动画 融合在一起的影像。夕阳余晖残留在窗边，生活感十足的小厨房里有旧木桌、洗到一半的马克杯、起雾的玻璃瓶、悬挂的抹布。画面带有智能手机单手拍摄的手抖、近距离对焦的犹豫、逆光曝光波动。要像在家中慌忙拍下某个不可思议事件的自然质感，不要广告影像的精心整理。声音只用厨房环境声与手绘生物柔和的电子音、小小的叫声。

stages.name: Original H3 control
stages.principle: 49 diffusion forwards with the original decoder and communication path.
stages.note: The denominator for every cumulative speedup claim.

stages.name: AdaLN TP1 / SP8
stages.principle: Replicate small AdaLN tensors and spend all eight ranks on sequence parallelism.
stages.note: Removes tensor-parallel collectives from a latency-dominated batch-one request.

stages.name: Explicit RDMA Ulysses exchange
stages.principle: Move the large sequence exchange through the topology-aware RDMA path.
stages.note: The gain is interconnect-path selection, not model approximation.

stages.name: Direct Q/K layout
stages.principle: Produce the attention layout directly and delete redundant transposes/copies.
stages.note: A small but repeatable layout win before distillation.

stages.name: Dense FastH3, four forwards
stages.principle: Use the distilled four-step sigma schedule [0.999, 0.749, 0.5, 0.25, 0].
stages.note: This is the largest single change and the first explicit quality boundary.

stages.name: FastH3 + VSA + FlashInfer
stages.principle: Apply visual sparse attention with exact FlashInfer sparse-kernel execution inside the distilled trajectory.
stages.note: VSA changes the attention graph; the kernel itself is exact for that sparse graph.

stages.name: GPU FP32-to-uint8 video pack
stages.principle: Quantize display pixels on GPU and copy uint8 instead of float frames.
stages.note: Semantics are unchanged at the MP4 contract boundary.

stages.name: Chunked pinned D2H + background mux
stages.principle: Overlap pinned host copies and CPU PyAV encode/mux with remaining device work.
stages.note: The POST endpoint still waits for a valid H.264/AAC MP4.

stages.name: Persistent RDMA communication
stages.principle: Reuse communication resources across layer iterations instead of reinitializing them.
stages.note: Reduces orchestration and allocator overhead.

stages.name: Fused VSA tile packing
stages.principle: Fuse tile selection and packing while preserving selected values and order.
stages.note: A kernel-launch and memory-traffic optimization.

stages.name: Compact VSA untile
stages.principle: Write only the compact valid output domain during sparse-attention reconstruction.
stages.note: Avoids materializing padding that no downstream operator consumes.

stages.name: Direct attention O path
stages.principle: Route attention output directly into its consumer.
stages.note: Retained for structural simplicity; the measured delta is within noise.

stages.name: Exact VAE/direct Q-to-K cleanup
stages.principle: Consolidate exact decoder and Q-to-K dataflow cleanups.
stages.note: A mixed cleanup bundle; it is not used to assign per-kernel causality.

stages.name: Online FP8 MLP
stages.principle: Use online FP8 for MLP GEMMs while retaining wider precision where sensitivity is higher.
stages.note: First low-precision compute boundary.

stages.name: MLP + output FP8
stages.principle: Extend FP8 to output projections with calibrated scaling.
stages.note: A conservative expansion before QKV/wire bundling.

stages.name: QKV E4M3 wire + O bundle
stages.principle: Transmit QKV in E4M3 and bundle output communication to reduce bytes and launch count.
stages.note: The accepted precision/communication endpoint before decoder replacement.

stages.name: TAEH3 decoder, FP32
stages.principle: Replace the full patch-parallel video VAE with the rank-local temporal autoencoder decoder.
stages.note: Removes decoder collectives and most video decode compute.

stages.name: TAEH3 decoder, FP16
stages.principle: Run TAEH3 convolution weights and activations in FP16.
stages.note: Post-codec FP32-vs-FP16 quality is separately audited.

stages.name: All-main FP8 coverage
stages.principle: Extend calibrated FP8 coverage across the remaining main DiT GEMM path.
stages.note: Completes the selected low-precision compute policy.

stages.name: Persistent RDMA steady state
stages.principle: Keep the optimized communication path persistent through the formal repeated run.
stages.note: First result close to the 15-second target.

stages.name: OMP=28 CPU orchestration
stages.principle: Right-size host parallelism for decode/encode orchestration on this node.
stages.note: First formal three-run mean below 15 seconds.

stages.name: Cross-rank Audio VAE
stages.principle: Decode video with TAEH3 on rank 0 while rank 1 independently runs Audio VAE.
stages.note: Final accepted result; profiler disabled, valid MP4 returned.
